key.name: auth-token
key.description: Yandex-Fotki authentication token, if logged in

key.name: access-phase-token
key.description: The authorization token for the currently logged in Tumblr user, if any

key.name: access-phase-token-secret
key.description: The cryptographic secret used to sign requests against the authorization token for the currently logged in Tumblr user, if any

key.name: access-phase-username
key.description: The user name of the currently logged in Flickr user, if any

key.name: default-size
key.description: A numeric code representing the default size for photos uploaded to Tumblr

key.name: default-blog
key.description: The name of the default blog of the user, if any

key.name: url
key.description: URL of the Rajce server

key.name: username
key.description: Rajce username, if logged in

key.name: token
key.description: user token, if remembered

key.name: last-category
key.description: The last selected Rajce category

key.name: last-photo-size
key.description: A numeric code representing the last photo size preset used when publishing to Rajce

key.name: remember
key.description: If true, remember last login

key.name: hide-album
key.description: If true, hide the newly created Rajce album

key.name: show-album
key.description: If true, open target album in the web browser just after uploading photos

key.name: strip-metadata
key.description: Whether images being uploaded to Rajce should have their metadata removed first

key.name: server-url
key.description: The base URL of the Nextcloud server to publish to, e.g. https://cloud.example.com

key.name: nc-user
key.description: The user name to authenticate with (filled automatically by the browser login flow)

key.name: remote-base
key.description: Remote folder on the Nextcloud server below which one folder per event is created

key.name: expire-days
key.description: Number of days after which a public link share expires; 0 means never

key.name: share-note
key.description: Optional note shown to recipients on the public link page of the share
